data.body: Landed: change 1334 merged to main as 9af88c3ada (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1; server-side rebase over 4213081d23). AC evidence: (1) scripts/check_wall_clock_asserts.py wired as CI 'wall-clock-assert gate' step in _build-and-test.yml beside the raw-git-write gate; teaching message names both escapes (reasoned '# timing: hang-guard — <reason>' marker and the skipif-CI perf-lane guard) and the counting-proxy migration. (2) Migrations: tests/unit/test_config_perf.py warm-resolution now spies cfg._ordered_layers (zero walks when warm) with RED-sim companion test_warm_resolution_proxy_detects_cache_regression (cache reset per call -> 10 walks, proxy fires); tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py gate-latency now counts Q.pending_enrichment probes + zero maybe_drain calls with RED-sim companion test_gate_proxy_detects_drain_path (forced soaked -> spawn fires). (3) 11 remaining sites carry reasoned hang-guard markers (lock reclaim, subprocess/LLM timeouts, shutdown bounds, boot budget); detector clean on tree at landing (CI gate green = enforce exit 0). (4) 13-test unit suite tests/unit/test_wall_clock_assert_lint.py: fire cases (elapsed, inline monotonic subtraction, elapsed_ms LE, multiline, reversed operands), marker escape + marker-without-reason fires, skipif-CI escapes, bare benchmark marker does NOT escape, lower-bound excluded, non-timing excluded, EXCLUDED_FILES self-exclusion, CLI exit codes + teaching message. Written RED-first (TDD).
